programCodes: Smart Renewables and Electrification Pathways Program

sentences.text: The contribution agreement for this $6.8M Smart Renewables and Electrification Pathways recipient carries a null description in the Open Data extract.
The program's most recent Departmental Results Report describes its purpose as enabling renewable electricity capacity additions and supporting clean grid integration.
Briefs in the SREPs program corpus typically state grid-integration outcomes, megawatt capacity additions, project location, and Indigenous-equity participation.
Comparable filings reference Greenhouse Gas Reductions targets in tonnes of CO2-equivalent over the life of the project.

unverifiable.rationale: The agreement description is null in the open dataset; comparable filings disclose these fields, but they cannot be inferred from the absence.
